narrative.overview: The review loop is a departure board. Every redaction state is a signal read at a glance, and the interface recedes into layered, mechanical depth: a charcoal/steel shell, a frosted toolbar, raised controls with soft accent glow, a recessed screenshot card, and split-flap tiles with a visible hinge seam. The world lends only what an Operate surface allows: the palette, condensed uppercase lettering, density, depth, and one signature move — the flip tile. The screenshot is always the subject. Navigation and controls stay native desktop conventions.
keyCharacteristics: Layered depth by default: shadows, top highlights, inset fields, never flat rectangles.
Charcoal/steel shell with amber (#FFB000) for active/selected and red (#B00020) for excluded/cancelled.
Condensed uppercase grotesque for labels and numerics; neutral grotesque for body copy.
Split-flap tiles as the signature: dimensional, hinged, and animated on state change.

rules.name: The Depth Rule
rules.body: Every surface layers over the one beneath it — a soft shadow, a top highlight, an inset field. A flat rectangle is a defect.

rules.name: The Amber-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the active flap, the selected box, and the primary action. Red marks what is cancelled or excluded. No other accent colors.

rules.name: The Label-Is-Short Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed type is for labels, numerics, and state; body copy stays in the neutral grotesque so it remains readable.

rules.name: The Layered-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are lifted at rest. Depth is the base state, not a hover effect.

rules.name: The Signal-Mark Rule
rules.body: A redaction box must read as a deliberate boundary over any screenshot: 2px solid signal color, square-ish corners, no decorative fills beyond a faint state tint.

rules.name: The Outer-Boundary Rule
rules.body: Suggested or copied boxes fully inside an already selected area are dropped; the selected outer boundary wins, so nested duplicates never stack up.

rules.name: The One-Signature Rule
rules.body: Motion is reserved for the flip tile and functional feedback: hover, focus, progress, and busy state. Nothing else animates decoratively.

dos: Layer every surface with depth — soft shadows, top highlights, inset fields — never flat fills.
Use amber for selected/active/primary and red for excluded/cancelled; the states must stay instantly legible.
Keep the screenshot centered and dominant, with the caption strip and signal board as secondary chrome.
Give every flip tile its hinge seam, top highlight, and value-swap animation.
donts: Flatten the shell or remove elevation.
Make the amber glow neon or introduce extra accent colors; the palette stays charcoal/steel/amber/red/white.
Overlay the screenshot with chips that cover its content; captions belong in the strip above the card.
Use body type for uppercase state labels or condensed caps for paragraphs.
Read as a cloud or consumer product; this is a local, offline engineering tool.
